profiles.display_name: Bambu P2S · 0.2 mm hardened steel · PLA baseline

long_line_minimum_length_mm.rationale: Four nozzle diameters separates intentional extended linework from compact dot-like debris while line width is evaluated independently.

maximum_tiny_hole_area_mm2.rationale: The area of a 0.4 mm diameter circle seeds review for enclosed negative features below roughly two nozzle diameters.

maximum_tiny_hole_diameter_mm.rationale: Negative details below two nozzle diameters are provisional review candidates until a printed hole sweep is measured.

minimum_gap_width_mm.rationale: A 1.25-nozzle gap is a provisional separation threshold that should be replaced by the first measured local coupon.

minimum_island_area_mm2.rationale: The area of a 0.3 mm diameter circle pairs with the diameter threshold so compact islands receive review without treating area alone as proof of failure.

minimum_island_diameter_mm.rationale: One and a half nozzle diameters is a conservative starting diameter for isolated dots pending the printed sweep.

minimum_line_width_mm.rationale: A 1.2-nozzle line width allows modest deposited-line spread while retaining long-line protection rather than deleting the feature.

minimum_neck_width_mm.rationale: One and a half nozzle diameters seeds a conservative supported-neck warning without claiming a measured breakage limit.

minimum_ring_width_mm.rationale: A ring wall of 1.5 nozzle diameters is provisionally required before offering a destructive ring-collapse action.

smoothing_radius_mm.rationale: Zero is the safe default: calibration should suggest warnings, never silently smooth or dilate artwork.
